summary: Inter Miami secured a dominant 3-1 victory over LA Galaxy, with Lionel Messi scoring twice. In the EPL, Arsenal moved top of the table after a last-minute winner against Chelsea. Manchester City announced the signing of a new striker ahead of the summer transfer window.
headlines: Messi brace fires Inter Miami past LA Galaxy
Arsenal go top after dramatic late winner vs Chelsea
Man City complete striker signing ahead of transfer window
Toronto FC appoint new head coach following poor run of form
EPL golden boot race tightens with three games remaining
